column1: # The parts of the program image that the build copies from your ROM: no code, only the graphics and
# the bytes outside the linked sections. tools/cps3rom1.py extract reads them from your ROM set (the
# program SIMM, decrypted) and pack puts them into the linked image. Objects named here are labels only
# (their names, and .RES for their bytes). "outside the linked sections" are bytes an earlier build left
# in the image the CD was made from; no source produces them.
# stored: how the program SIMM holds them (encrypted like the program, or plain).
